_comment: Open-source Switch homebrew the nightly compatibility workflow builds and runs. See compat/README.md for the fields and the rules an entry must satisfy.

apps.name: libnx-application
apps.title: switch-examples: templates/application
apps.notes: libnx console template: prints to the console and exits on Plus.

apps.name: sdl2-simple
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/sdl2/sdl2-simple
apps.notes: SDL2 renderer (devkitPro's Switch SDL2, GL-backed) drawing coloured rectangles; SDL turns the applet exit request into SDL_QUIT, which this example ignores, so the input script presses Plus, its own exit button.

apps.name: hbmenu
apps.title: nx-hbmenu
apps.notes: The homebrew menu: software-rendered framebuffer, lists sdmc:/switch, nxlink listener.

apps.name: opengl-triangle
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/opengl/simple_triangle
apps.notes: OpenGL ES through Mesa (nouveau) and EGL: one shaded triangle.

apps.name: playtone
apps.title: switch-examples: audio/playtone
apps.notes: audout: plays tones when buttons are pressed (console UI).

apps.name: deko-basic
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/deko3d/deko_basic
apps.notes: deko3d: clears the screen with a changing colour.

apps.name: read-controls
apps.title: switch-examples: hid/read-controls
apps.notes: hid: prints the buttons and sticks to the console.

apps.name: simplegfx
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/simplegfx
apps.notes: libnx framebuffer: fills the screen with a gradient.

apps.name: romfs-example
apps.title: switch-examples: fs/romfs
apps.notes: fs: reads a file from its own RomFS and prints it.

apps.name: curl-example
apps.title: switch-examples: network/curl
apps.notes: network: nifm + bsd + sfdnsres; fetches a page with curl over TLS.

apps.name: ftpd
apps.title: ftpd
apps.build: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq zstd imagemagick > /dev/null && cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=/opt/devkitpro/cmake/Switch.cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build -j4
apps.notes: FTP server: deko3d-backed Dear ImGui UI, sockets, exits on Plus. Pinned past v3.2.1 (whose FreeBSD collate.c has old-style definitions GCC 15 rejects); its assets need zstd and ImageMagick, installed with apt in the container.

apps.name: hb-appstore
apps.title: hb-appstore
apps.notes: Homebrew App Store: SDL2 (chesto), curl over TLS to the repository, fonts via SDL_ttf. Build workarounds for current portlibs and GCC 15: -D_GNU_SOURCE (chesto's -D_XOPEN_SOURCE hides strdup, now an error), harfbuzz linked in (freetype 2.13 needs it, chesto's link line predates that), serial make (chesto's Makefile races under -j).

apps.name: nx-shell
apps.title: NX-Shell
apps.build: sed -i '1i #include <ctime>' source/popups/properties.cpp && mkdir -p build/bin && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec aarch64-none-elf-pkg-config freetype2 "$@"\n' > build/bin/freetype-config && chmod +x build/bin/freetype-config && PATH="$PWD/build/bin:$PATH" make -j4
apps.notes: File manager: Dear ImGui over GLFW and Mesa, lists sdmc:/. Build fixes for GCC 15: a missing <ctime> include, and a freetype-config shim over pkg-config since freetype 2.13 no longer ships it.

apps.name: jksv
apps.title: JKSV
apps.notes: Save backup manager (its own SDL2-based UI, acc, ns, pdm); ref is the 12/02/2025 release, pinned by sha because the tag name contains slashes.

apps.name: switchident
apps.title: SwitchIdent
apps.notes: System information viewer: SDL2 renderer, SDL_ttf, set:sys, nifm, psm, ts.

apps.name: noods
apps.title: NooDS
apps.notes: DS emulator: libnx + EGL/Mesa UI, reaches its file browser without a ROM. Only a rolling 'release' tag upstream, so pinned by sha.

apps.name: mgba
apps.title: mGBA
apps.notes: GBA emulator: libnx + EGL/Mesa GUI, file browser without a ROM.

apps.name: open-supaplex
apps.title: OpenSupaplex
apps.licence: GPL-3.0 (reimplementation); game resources are the freeware Supaplex release
apps.notes: Supaplex reimplemented in C over SDL2 (stock Switch SDL2); its data (released as freeware by its authors) ships in the repository and is copied to sdmc:/switch/OpenSupaplex. A presses through the title screens.

apps.name: spacenx
apps.title: SpaceNX
apps.notes: Small SDL2 space shooter with everything drawn in code (no data files); it reads the pad itself and leaves on Minus, which the input script presses. Makefile.libnx predates the current toolchain, so the build passes CFLAGS (-fpermissive and -fcommon: GCC 15 rejects its return-type and pointer-type mismatches and its tentative definitions in a header) and LIBS (SDL2 now needs EGL, glapi, drm_nouveau and libstdc++ for Mesa) whole.

apps.name: vgedit
apps.title: vgedit
apps.sdmc_setup: mkdir -p switch && echo 'hello from the sd card' > switch/note.txt
apps.notes: Text editor and file browser on chesto (SDL2); same build workarounds as hb-appstore (shared library code).

apps.name: es2gears
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/opengl/es2gears
apps.notes: OpenGL ES 2 gears through Mesa: more draw calls and depth than the triangle.

apps.name: textured-cube
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/opengl/textured_cube
apps.notes: OpenGL ES textured cube through Mesa: texture upload and sampling.

apps.name: audren-simple
apps.title: switch-examples: audio/audren-simple
apps.notes: audren:u, the audio renderer (not audout): a blocker for most games with music.

apps.name: shared-font
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/shared_font
apps.notes: pl:u: draws text with the system's shared font.

apps.name: account
apps.title: switch-examples: account
apps.notes: acc:u1: lists the users and their profile images.

apps.name: save-example
apps.title: switch-examples: fs/save
apps.notes: fs: mounts save data for the current title and reads it.

apps.name: software-keyboard
apps.title: switch-examples: applet/libapplets/software-keyboard
apps.notes: library applets: opens the software keyboard (swkbd) and prints what it returns.

apps.name: sdl2-demo
apps.title: switch-examples: graphics/sdl2/sdl2-demo
apps.notes: SDL2 with SDL_image, SDL_ttf and SDL_mixer: images, text and music through the stock Switch SDL2.
